notes.title: You can now Playtest Muri: Wildwoods! ˚ ｡⋆
notes.content:
[h2]✧*̥˚ [b]IT’S TIME![/b] *̥˚✧[/h2][h3]You can now playtest Muri: Wildwoods here on Steam!!![/h3][previewyoutube="rzp5BgQDl04;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3]Some info[/h3][p]📅 The playtest is open to play from today the [b]20th of August until September 3rd[/b]. Make sure to get yourself, your family, your friends, your nephew and niece, [u]signed up before this Sunday the 24th[/u] when the signups close. If you’re already signed up before this date you will, as mentioned above, still be able to playtest the game in piece until the 3rd of September. 
[/p][p]⚠️ [b]This is a playtest of Muri: Wildwoods,[/b] [b]not a demo[/b]. That means the game does not have its final look, some things are currently a work in progress, the game might be a bit laggy or might even crash, and you may experience some bugs, but the game is ([i]hopefully[/i]) playable and we’d love for you to try it, give us some feedback, and let us know how it runs on your PC - so please answer the survey at the end of your test, find a link to it in the game. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45334384/51acd65e295cf8c0f712e58b787b5df605f570d1.gif"][/img][/p][p]🍰 This slice of Muri: Wildwoods is from the one of the earlier areas you visit in the game, we call it the Ravines. [b]The full playtest should take around 30-60 minutes[/b], it depends on how much you want to complete and also how much time you spend petting the critters or watching the beautiful nature restore![/p][p][/p][p]🧩 This playtest should show you some of the core gameplay planned for Muri: Wildwoods; exploration, cleaning, cute critters, some smaller puzzle solving, platforming, and yes, more cleaning! [/p][p][/p][p]📋 Please feel free to share your experience and report feedback to us, there’s a form you can access in the game but you can also hop into our Discord and chat directly with our devs, [url="https://discord.gg/juPPejMsaF"][u]click here to join the server![/u][/url]
[/p][p]📷 It’s also a-okay, [i]even encouraged[/i], to [b]share screenshots, videos, or streams of the playtest[/b], so from us devs: Please have fun and be as creative as you’d like! We’re so excited to see you all play this small part of our game and hope you enjoy it as much as we enjoy making it. 
[/p][p]❓ [b]Need help?[/b] Write in our [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3509370/discussions/"]Steam Discussions[/url] or use the link above to hop into the Discord to reach us![/p][p] [/p][p][b]Have fun![/b][/p][p]🎮 [i]The Speldosa Team[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾ [/p][h3][b]✧*̥ ˚ Join our Community *̥ ˚✧[/b] [/h3][p][url="https://discord.gg/juPPejMsaF" style="button"]Discord[/url]  [url="https://twitter.com/speldosagames" style="button"]Twitter[/url]  [url="https://www.instagram.com/speldosagames" style="button"]Instagram[/url][/p][p][url="https://bsky.app/profile/speldosa.bsky.social" style="button"]Bluesky[/url]   [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@speldosagames" style="button"]TikTok[/url]   [url="https://www.threads.net/@speldosagames" style="button"]Threads[/url] [/p][p][/p][p]Press and other business inquiries, reach us here: [url="https://contact@speldosa.com"]contact@speldosa.com[/url][/p][p]  [/p][h3]↶ Wishlist Muri: Wildwoods ↷[/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3284200/Muri_Wildwoods/"][/dynamiclink]  [/p][h3]↶ Try the prologue Project Shoreline ↷[/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3158500/Project_Shoreline/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: ✧ ˚ Sign up for Playtest!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, fellow Murii! [/h3]
Exciting news! This week we're part of [b]WINGS [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/womensdaysale]Women's Day Sale[/url][/b] on Steam, and tonight ([i]March 6th at 4 PM PT / 7 PM ET[/i]), we’ll be featured in the Women-Led Games Showcase on [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QvjEUilTbrc&ab_channel=IGN]IGN[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/@gamespot/streams]GameSpot[/url], and [url=https://www.youtube.com/@Women-LedGames]WLG Youtube[/url]! 

We’re so happy to see games by women being celebrated—especially since half our team is made up of women and non-binary devs! If you haven’t already, check out some of the amazing games in the event—and don’t miss our trailer on the [i]big screen[/i]! 😁

[previewyoutube=QvjEUilTbrc;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Sign up for playtesting![/h3]
To celebrate this, we’re gathering playtesters until the end of the event! Sign up before [b]Sunday, March 9th[/b] for a chance to help us test [i]Muri: Wildwoods[/i]! You’ll find the sign-up button on our Steam page. ♡

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3284200/Muri_Wildwoods/?curator_clanid=45512431

[h3]Development Updates![/h3]
Exciting things are happening in development, and we just hit 2.5K wishlists—thank you so much for your support! 💖 Here are some things we've been working on:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45334384/9d193e17a597af424a0d6a59e73cf3d00c4f917c.gif[/img]
[i]We added so that you can pet critters![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45334384/58d66dfd14c9da3a0b2ec2ed41794871e393a420.gif[/img]
[i]More colorful and interesting nature to clean—check out these Tiger Eyes! [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45334384/cae64977740bb216da0da43b70cd06fe85173bd0.gif[/img]
[i]Our tech and art team have created some more satisfying restoration VFX, we hope you'll like this![/i]

That’s it for now—see you again soon™

[b]Best wishes,[/b]
🎮 The Speldosa Team
